mapper.select:
SELECT id, task_code as taskCode, task_name as taskName, remark as remark, enable as enable, is_dynamic_class as isDynamicClass, exec_type as execType, cron as cron, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime, create_by as createBy FROM auto_task
and id = #{taskId}

SELECT id, task_id as taskId, step_sort as stepSort, class_type as classType, class_full_name as classFullName, method_name as methodName, dynamic_source as dynamicSource, remark as remark, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime FROM auto_task_step
and task_id = #{taskId}

SELECT id, step_id as stepId, param_index as paramIndex, param_type as paramType, param_value as paramValue, param_class_name as paramClassName, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime FROM auto_task_param
and step_id = #{stepId}

select SELECT id, step_id as stepId, param_index as paramIndex, param_type as paramType, param_value as paramValue, param_class_name as paramClassName, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime FROM auto_task_param where step_id in (select id from auto_task_step where task_id = #{taskId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auto_task (task_code, task_name, remark, enable, is_dynamic_class, exec_type, cron, create_time, update_time, create_by) VALUES (#{taskCode}, #{taskName}, #{remark}, #{enable}, #{isDynamicClass}, #{execType}, #{cron}, now(), now(), #{createBy})

INSERT INTO auto_task_step (task_id, step_sort, class_type, class_full_name, method_name, dynamic_source, remark, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{step.taskId}, #{step.stepSort}, #{step.classType}, #{step.classFullName}, #{step.methodName}, #{step.dynamicSource}, #{step.remark}, now(), now())

INSERT INTO auto_task_param (step_id, param_index, param_type, param_value, param_class_name, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{param.stepId}, #{param.paramIndex}, #{param.paramType}, #{param.paramValue}, #{param.paramClassName}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update auto_task set task_code = #{taskCode}, task_name = #{taskName}, remark = #{remark}, enable = #{enable}, is_dynamic_class = #{isDynamicClass}, exec_type = #{execType}, cron = #{cron}, update_time = now(), create_by = #{createBy} where id = #{id}

update auto_task_step set task_id = #{taskId}, step_sort = #{stepSort}, class_type = #{classType}, class_full_name = #{classFullName}, method_name = #{methodName}, dynamic_source = #{dynamicSource}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}

update auto_task_param set step_id = #{stepId}, param_index = #{paramIndex}, param_type = #{paramType}, param_value = #{paramValue}, param_class_name = #{paramClassName}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
